title: ReCap Pro workflows and connector status
description: Explore ReCap Pro workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Autodesk

ReCap Pro

Autodesk ReCap Pro supports reality capture, point-cloud registration and scan-to-design preparation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Register a scan set

Begin with the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended ReCap Pro preview, register a scan set; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Clean a point cloud

Use the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended ReCap Pro preview, clean a point cloud; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Publish design context

Start from the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended ReCap Pro preview, publish design context; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
